title: Netherlands and Germany Face Off in Nations League Opener
seoTitle: Netherlands vs Germany: Nations League Opener
subtitle: Xavi debuts as Netherlands manager while Klopp leads Germany in decisive clash
excerpt: In the Nations League Group A2 opener, the Netherlands and Germany face off in Amsterdam. Check out lineups, absences, and the latest betting odds.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Thursday, September 24, 2026, the Netherlands host Germany in the UEFA Nations League Group A2 opener. The clash gains prominence as Xavi takes charge of the Dutch national team and Jürgen Klopp leads Germany, with both sides still feeling the weight of their World Cup eliminations.

Predicted lineups for the Netherlands

According to expert analysis, the probable Dutch lineup features Bart Verbruggen in goal; Denzel Dumfries, Jan Paul van Hecke, Virgil van Dijk (captain), and Micky van de Ven in defense; Joey Veerman, Ryan Gravenberch, and Tijjani Reijnders in midfield; and Crysencio Summerville, Brian Brobbey, and Cody Gakpo in attack.

Absences impacting the Dutch midfield

Frenkie de Jong and Jerdy Schouten remain unavailable, forcing Xavi to field a midfield consisting of Veerman, Gravenberch, and Reijnders. De Jong's absence reduces central creativity, while Schouten's absence limits transition options.

Germany's absentees

Germany enters the pitch without Schlotterbeck, Goretzka, and Stiller. The manager confirmed Stefan Stegen as the starter between the posts, although Alexander Nübel may also be considered. In midfield, Kimmich takes on the role of deep-lying playmaker and Jamal Musiala continues as the main playmaker.

Odds and goal expectations

Bookmakers price a Dutch victory at 2.40, a draw at 3.70, and a German victory at 2.63. The goal market indicates over 2.5 goals at 1.50 and both teams to score at 1.45, reflecting expectations of an attacking clash.

Head-to-head history and importance of the point

In 48 head-to-head meetings, Germany has 18 wins compared to 12 for the Netherlands, with the remainder ending in draws. However, home advantage and current odds point to the Netherlands as slight favorites in this decisive match of a short group stage.

With information from NETVASCO, Goal.com.
